title: API database password typo
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the wrong‑password problem due to the deployment, and the deployment as the trigger.
option_titles: Rollback API to previous known-good image
root_cause: The API container's deployment of version 2.3.2 introduced an incorrect database password for the 'shop' user, causing all API-to-DB connections to fail with password authentication errors.
truth: api 2.3.2 was deployed with a typo in the DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable, so the application cannot authenticate to PostgreSQL.
